description: Multi-value (title/doi/publication_year positional alignment) patch for the v2060 workbook. The 16 rows are identical (title/doi/year) to v2055, so the Crossref-verified v2056 correction is reused. Extractor applies a patch only when the current doi string matches 'expected.doi'; otherwise it warns and skips (future edits are not clobbered).
